{{Top|leg}}
'''Security Patrol''' was one of the six main departments of [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. The head of Security Patrol was a member of the [[Executives]]. The department was responsible for the security of LMC mining operations. The Patrol operated several classes of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including modified [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] and [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruisers]].
